fallback_model.description: one-shot fallback override on provider/auth failure (exit 20/21); empty = .ai-sdlc.yaml model.fallback

ledger_head.description: upstream run-ledger chain head (e.g. needs.intake.outputs.ledger_head) — seeds this stage entry prev; empty = genesis (issue #196)

model.description: engine model route override; empty = .ai-sdlc.yaml model.primary

org_config.description: org baseline contract ref owner/repo[/path][@ref] — org floor per spec/org-policy.md; empty = repo contract + defaults

provider_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible inference base URL; empty → vars.AI_SDLC_PROVIDER_URL → GitHub Models default

runtime_ref.description: ref of os-santiago/ai-sdlc to fetch runtime scripts/actions from

exit_code.description: final engine exit code (fallback run when it fired, else primary)

fallback_used.description: 'true' when the fallback model run fired

ledger_head.description: sealed run-ledger chain head — also stamped on the PR as an ai-sdlc:ledger-head marker (issue #196)

model.description: model id of the run that produced exit_code

pr_number.description: PR opened by this run (empty when exit_code != 0); feeds post-implement review (issue #28)

primary_exit.description: engine exit code of the primary-model run

stall_class.description: engine-stall classification of the final run (ok|transport|tooling|spec|budget|livelock; issue #158); empty = unclassified

AI_SDLC_APP_ID.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App id — mints the per-run installation token used for all git/gh auth (fail-closed when unset; issue #26)

AI_SDLC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App private key (PEM) — pairs with AI_SDLC_APP_ID

AI_SDLC_LEDGER_KEY.description: run-ledger signing key (PEM; Ed25519/RSA) — seals stage evidence; absent = unsigned seal (issue #196)

MODEL_API_KEY.description: API key the engine uses (OPENAI_API_KEY surface)
